# HanovaDevs

> Software company founded in 2022 by Ali Haider. Custom software, web development, ecommerce, AI automation, SEO and analytics, and brand identity.

## Company information
- [About and founder](https://hanovadevs.com/about): Company story, founder profile, and frequently asked questions.
- [Ali Haider](https://ali.hanovadevs.com): Founder website supplied by HanovaDevs.
- [Hira Maqsood](https://hanovadevs.com/team/hira-maqsood): Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer; original ideas, creative problem-solving, strategic planning, operations and delivery.
- [Contact](https://hanovadevs.com/contact): Project enquiries; contact@hanovadevs.com.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hanova-devs): Company profile.

## Work and services
- [Services](https://hanovadevs.com/services): Scope of available services.

## Products
- [Eunoia](https://hanovadevs.com/products/eunoia): Desktop personal workspace; available on Microsoft Store.
- [Eunoia official store listing](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PJ36VD01Z4X): Current release, requirements and store availability.
- [Omnai Browser](https://hanovadevs.com/products/omnai): AI-focused desktop browser, launching soon. Public release date not announced.
